introduction:
In Telangana, the Caste Certificate is issued by the Tahsildar (Revenue Department) for SC, ST, BC (Backward Classes — A, B, C, D, E), and EWS applicants. The certificate is essential for educational reservations, government job applications, and welfare scheme benefits.

Applications can be submitted online through the Mee Seva / TS e-Pass Portal or offline at the nearest Mee Seva centre or Tahsildar office. Telangana has a unique BC classification system with 5 sub-groups (A–E).
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Service Name: Community Certificate (also integrated as Community, Nativity & Date of Birth Certificate / Caste Certificate)
  • State: Telangana
  • Target Categories: SC, ST, and BC categories
  • Official Portal: MeeSeva 2.0 (ts.meeseva.telangana.gov.in)
  • Application Fee: Rs. 45 (for online application)
  • Delivery Method: Manual (Visit MeeSeva to print upon approval) or Postal
documentsRequired:
Documents Required

Format Guidelines: For the online portal, all documents must be scanned, saved in PDF format, and be under 2 MB in size each.
Caste Proof (Upload 1)

An old Caste Certificate issued to any family member previously. If no family member has one, you must obtain and upload a verification letter from your Caste Association (Kula Sangam).

Education/Age Proof (Upload 2)

10th Class Bonafide Certificate OR Date of Birth Certificate.

Identity/Address Proof (Upload 3)

Ration Card OR Aadhaar Card OR Voter ID.
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Online Application via MeeSeva 2.0 Portal

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Visit Portal & Login: Open a web browser and search for "MeeSeva 2.0 login" to access the official portal (ts.meeseva.telangana.gov.in). Log in using your Login ID and Password. (If you don't have an account, click on "New User" to register).
  2. Aadhaar Authentication: Enter the OTP sent to your registered mobile number and click "Authenticate".
  3. Select Caste Service: On the MeeSeva dashboard, type "Caste" in the top search bar. From the results, select "Community Certificate" (do not select Brahmin Community unless applicable). Choose your Caste Type (SC, ST, or BC).
  4. Fetch/Verify Records: Under the search options, enter the MeeSeva Application Number of a family member (if they have an older certificate) OR enter the applicant's Aadhaar Number. Click "Get Details".
  5. Initiate Application: Click on "New Application" to open the form.
  6. Applicant Details: Fill in Applicant Name, Gender, Father/Husband's Name, Mother's Name, and Mobile Number. Set Delivery Type to "Manual" if you want to print it later at a MeeSeva center.
  7. Address Details: Fill in your House Number, Area, District, Mandal, Village, and Pincode. Check the box if your permanent address is the same as the delivery address.
  8. Service Specific Details:
    • Select "Yes" or "No" regarding whether a caste certificate was previously issued to family members.
    • Leave "Survey Number" blank if it doesn't apply.
    • Select your Sub-Caste category (e.g., BC-A, BC-B, etc.) and then select your exact caste from the dropdown.
    • Select the Father's Caste, Mother's Caste, and Religion.
    • Specify if the applicant is a natural son/daughter or adopted.
  9. Upload Documents: Upload the 3 required documents in the specified PDF format (under 2 MB each).
  10. Payment: Click "Show Payment". Verify the Rs. 45 fee and click "Confirm Payment". Select a payment gateway (HDFC, Paytm, etc.) and pay using UPI, Card, or Net Banking. Save and print the Acknowledgment Receipt.
Physical Visit Verification Requirements:
  • If you submitted a family member's past certificate as proof: Take the printed receipt to the nearest MeeSeva center, and they will print and issue the new certificate immediately.
  • If you applied fresh (without past family certificates): Take the printed online receipt along with physical copies of the uploaded documents and submit them to your nearby Tahsildar (MRO) office or Gram Panchayat office for physical verification.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Assisted Offline Application (via MeeSeva Center)

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Visit MeeSeva Center: Visit your nearest authorized MeeSeva Center.
  2. Get Form: Request a physical application form for the Community/Caste Certificate (forms are usually sold for Rs. 10 or can be downloaded from the MeeSeva portal).
  3. Fill Details: Fill out the application form with your personal details, address, and caste information.
  4. Attach Documents: Attach photocopies of your required documents (Aadhaar/Ration Card, Bonafide/DOB Certificate, and previous family caste certificate or Kula Sangam letter).
  5. Submit: Submit the filled form and documents to the MeeSeva operator.
  6. Pay Fee: Pay the required application fee (approx. Rs. 45) in cash at the counter.
  7. Collect Receipt: The operator will file the application online for you and provide you with an acknowledgment receipt carrying your Application Number.
afterApplying:
After Applying — Status Tracking & Print Collection

Keep Receipt & Track

Keep the Acknowledgment Receipt safe, as it contains your Application Number required for tracking the status of your certificate.

Verification & Approval

Once the physical verification is complete by the MRO/Gram Panchayat (if applying fresh), or immediately (if applying using older proofs), the certificate will be approved. You will receive a success SMS notification on your registered mobile number stating that the certificate has been generated.

Collection Printing

Visit any nearby MeeSeva center, show them your receipt or application number, and they will print the final, authorized certificate for you.
